plan: Deep-copy the recipe on entry so adapt never mutates its inputs; print_original returns authored_text verbatim.

Collect shared views: all instruction lists and ingredient lists from the recipe body and components, plus one mutable equipment set, so substitutions, wording rewrites, and exclusion checks reach everywhere.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with a per-ingredient chain loop: pick the catalog choice by min(priority, catalog index) for determinism, apply name/quantity_factor/unit/preparation, global wording changes, equipment adds/removals, and append deep-copied additional ingredients to a growing worklist processed under the same rules.
Track visited names per chain to detect substitution cycles; missing catalog entries yield 'no substitution for NAME'; a replacement that is itself excluded emits a warning and continues the chain.

Accumulate reasons instead of exiting early: resolve every ingredient even after failures, then check all required equipment against available_equipment, returning every independently applicable reason sorted, with recipe null and considered choices retained.

Scale only on success: multiply every quantity by target_yield/yield using Fraction arithmetic, set the yield, sort equipment lists, and return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons} with ordered choices and sorted warnings.
mechanisms: copy-on-entry input immutability (deepcopy work object, verbatim authored_text return)
shared instruction/ingredient list registry spanning body and components for global effect application
deterministic catalog selection via min over (priority, catalog index) tuples
per-ingredient chain loop with visited-name set for chained substitution and cycle detection
growing-worklist iteration so additional ingredients undergo the same exclusion/catalog processing
in-place global wording rewrite via str.replace across all instruction lists
set-based equipment accumulation with add/discard edits and post-pass availability check
exhaustive reason accumulation in a set with sorted emission (no early exit)
deferred rational scaling by Fraction factor target_yield/yield applied only on success
